top_signal.title: Offered Local Print Business for 25k- Update w/ more info.
top_signal.summary: Previous Post     Equipment Images  (Not pictured 26x70 printer, either Epson Surecolor or HP design jet, missed snagging a pic.)     P&L 2023 to 2025    Hi all, I took a good look at all the advice I got in my previous post and have a little more information after meeting with the current owner today. I would still like advice on these particular numbers, largely because I still feel unsure about if I am somehow being a blind fool for even considering this.     Shop Background:  Current owner is the 2nd owner, just after the original owner and has had the business since 2020. The shop is located in a small town (>3,000) but with 2 larger universities located within an hour driving distance, and a large part of the shops profits come from local farms.    Their largest client is a local farm that makes up about 50% of their annual business at 40k-70k depending on the harvest.    Current owner says monthly gross is about 8k on average. He owns the building and has offered to bundle the utilities into the rent, which would be 800/m.    There were 2 full time employees, but they have left since it is closing. If I hired on an employee, I was considering a part time position for office work, about 1500 to 2k per month expense-wise. Owner says that he took home ~3k monthly.     My Background : I have been an artist/designer for about 10+ years now, so Adobe, canva, all that programming and 'front of shop' or formatting stuff I am well versed in. I do not have much knowledge
